node.text: Taken from your wallpaper; made lighter or darker where needed so text stays readable.
Resting the mouse on a button shows its name and keys
A video opened from a desktop window (DeX) fills the screen; Android 14 and later. Nağmedar's window opens where and as large as you left it.
With Ctrl the wheel does the other
In the library a middle click queues the film or the track; the back and forward buttons move between screens
